integrity: Proof uses explicit positive-matrix asymptotics; numerical checks corroborate but do not certify limits. Attribution of prior fixation theory and residual historical-priority risk are described in the review. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Deterministic infinite-population, linear genotype-independent stage transport and positive fixed pulses; requires interior allele frequencies and at least one selected stage; no finite-population fixation time or uniform near-zero dominance crossover.
title: An exact dominance transition in stage-structured pulsed resistance fixation
